ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the child care fraud scheme in Minnesota, including the individuals and organizations involved, and the impact on the state's budget.
questions: What is the extent of the child care fraud scheme in Minnesota?
How much money has been lost to fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme, and could lead to significant changes in the way child care programs are funded and regulated in Minnesota.
